name: Grubnak

stages.title: Grubnak
stages.description: The runt of a green-skinned war-race that squabbles in the caves and fields past the frontier towns. It worships a strength it doesn't have yet, guards a pointy stick like treasure, and starts fights it fully intends to lose.

stages.title: Grubnak the Scrapper
stages.description: Bigger, greyer, and finally strong enough to back up the mouth. It's traded the stick for a real spear and a scrap of looted armor, and now drags the smaller goblins into 'glorious' skirmishes over scrap.

stages.title: Warchief Grubnak
stages.description: Swollen into the near-extinct, ogre-blooded warrior strain the tribes only whisper about — a slab of muscle and dogma that fights in the name of the war god. When it roars, the whole warband moves.

lore: Grubnak talks big and fights bigger than its size suggests — most of its scars are from tripping over its own weapon, not from battle.
goldenLore: The runt that clawed its way to warchief and never once stopped. Gilded in its own legend, it leads a warband that would follow it into the abyss itself.

name: Skitterscour

stages.title: Skitterscour
stages.description: A grey sewer-rat grown to the size of a dog, all whiskers and appetite. It fears cats, brooms, and absolutely nothing else.

stages.title: Skitterscour the Gnawer
stages.description: A scarred, stronghold-bred gnawer that has survived every trap set for it and eaten most of them. Its teeth never stop growing, so it never stops chewing.

stages.title: Ratking Skitterscour
stages.description: The bloated rat-lord of the under-sewers, ringed by a squeaking court of its own descendants. It rules the dark below the city and considers the city above a rumor.

lore: Skitterscour has never met a hole it wouldn't dig, a crumb it wouldn't chase, or a fight it could actually win — and it doesn't care.
goldenLore: Sovereign of every warren, drain, and forgotten cellar. It has gnawed its way to a crown, and dares the daylight to come take it back.

name: Cluckabee

stages.title: Cluckabee
stages.description: A small barnyard chicken with delusions of grandeur roughly forty times its body weight. It has declared war on a scarecrow and is, so far, losing.

stages.title: Cluckabee the Bold
stages.description: Bolder now, and somehow louder — a puffed-up battle-fowl that struts the frontlines of conflicts no one else can see. The feathers are for intimidation. It is not working.

stages.title: Talonlord Cluckabee
stages.description: A cloaked, spur-taloned rooster-warlord straight out of a barnyard legend nobody asked for. It cannot actually fight, but it has never let a small thing like that slow it down.

lore: Cluckabee firmly believes it is the fiercest warrior in all the land. It has never once been proven wrong to its face.
goldenLore: The undying rooster of legend, crowing at a sunrise it personally takes credit for. Feared by worms, respected by no one, eternal all the same.

name: Woolder

stages.title: Woolder
stages.description: A round, fuzzy cub with a farmyard temperament and a talent for napping in doorways. It has never met a fence it couldn't lean on until it fell over.

stages.title: Woolder the Steadfast
stages.description: Grown broad and grizzled, a steadfast bruin that ambles the treeline and settles arguments by sitting on them. Slow to anger, impossible to move once it is.

stages.title: Bruinlord Woolder
stages.description: The great shaggy bear-lord of the deep woods, thick-pelted and mountain-shouldered. Whole hunting parties have turned around rather than wake it.

lore: Woolder has broken exactly one fence in its life and considers this its greatest achievement.
goldenLore: Elder of every forest that ever kept it warm. It broke one fence in its youth and still counts it, fondly, as its finest hour.

name: Pindlewick

stages.title: Pindlewick
stages.description: A small red horned imp that blinks in and out of sight, pockets already full of things that were recently yours. It teleports mostly to avoid consequences.

stages.title: Pindlewick the Sly
stages.description: A sly, quicker imp with a hoard and a grudge, running rings around anyone slow enough to reach for it. Half its tricks are magic; the other half are just nerve.

stages.title: Trickster-King Pindlewick
stages.description: Grown at last into a proper trickster-demon, crowned in stolen trinkets and cackling smoke. It could rule the lower halls — it would just rather rob them.

lore: Pindlewick has never stolen anything it needed. It just likes having things that used to be yours.
goldenLore: Hoarder of all, keeper of nothing it earned honestly. Its pile of gilded plunder is now taller than the demon lords who tried to tax it.

name: Bananip

stages.title: Bananip
stages.description: A small, defenseless jungle monkey with fast hands and faster loyalty to its own stomach. It will trade you anything for a banana, including your other bananas.

stages.title: Bananip the Vambraced
stages.description: Grown into a huge brutish jungle-guard, its forearms wrapped in dangerous-looking vambraces. It pounds its chest, mends its own wounds mid-brawl, and guards its grove like a temple.

stages.title: Warcrown Bananip
stages.description: A war-crowned ape of genuinely fearsome build, fluent in every fighting style and above using only one. Even the cavern beasts give its territory a respectful gap.

lore: Bananip will trade almost anything for a banana, including several things that were never Bananip's to trade.
goldenLore: Sovereign of the whole jungle canopy, throne piled high with tribute fruit. It rules with an iron fist and a very sticky one.

name: Grottlecap

stages.title: Grottlecap
stages.description: A shy walking mushroom that hides among ordinary fungi and waits, dreaming small damp dreams, until something disturbs it. Then it is briefly and confusingly hostile.

stages.title: Grottlecap the Sporespun
stages.description: A spore-spun fungal beast the size of a stump, trailing a cloud of drowsy dust wherever it shambles. Cut it and it simply grows the piece back, mildly offended.

stages.title: Eldercap Grottlecap
stages.description: An ancient cavern-elder of fungus and rot, older than the forest floor it sprouted from. It speaks, when it speaks at all, in slow puffs of glowing spores.

lore: Grottlecap is convinced it is a very tall mushroom rather than a creature, and refuses all evidence to the contrary.
goldenLore: Grove-eternal, root-deep, and utterly certain it is simply a very tall mushroom. The grove has stopped arguing and started worshipping.

name: Clackerdown

stages.title: Clackerdown
stages.description: A camouflaged shore-crab that spends its life impersonating a rock and resents being noticed. Step too close and the 'rock' develops opinions and pincers.

stages.title: Clackerdown the Boulderback
stages.description: A boulder-backed crab with a shell like a small fortress and the patience of one under siege. It has held the same tide-pool for years out of pure stubbornness.

stages.title: Seawall Clackerdown
stages.description: The armored king of the sea-wall, a crab grown into living breakwater, pincers that fold ship-timbers. The tide comes in, breaks against it, and leaves disappointed.

lore: Clackerdown once held a beach against the tide for six hours. The tide, reportedly, is still embarrassed.
goldenLore: Tide-unmoved, storm-unbothered, sovereign of one very specific beach. It once held that beach against the ocean for six hours; the ocean still won't discuss it.

name: Barkuff

stages.title: Barkuff
stages.description: A scruffy, watchful pup that guards whatever you last set down as if it were a hoard of gold. Especially, and non-negotiably, your lunch.

stages.title: Barkuff the Watchful
stages.description: A lean guard-dog gone half-wild, ears up at every snapped twig on the road. Loyal to a fault, suspicious of everything, asleep only in theory.

stages.title: Feralfang Barkuff
stages.description: A feral-fanged pack-hound, scarred and enormous, leading a hunt across the moors by moonlight. It still comes when you whistle — it just brings the whole pack now.

lore: Barkuff guards whatever you set down last as if it were the crown jewels. Especially your lunch.
goldenLore: Ever-loyal, ever-hungry, and now the size of a small horse. It has guarded your belongings so long it has honestly forgotten they were ever yours.

name: Bouldergrum

stages.title: Bouldergrum
stages.description: A young giant, big enough to be a menace and clumsy enough to be a bigger one. It means well, mostly, and apologizes to the doorframes it destroys.

stages.title: Bouldergrum the Frosthide
stages.description: A frost-hided mountain giant that carries its own weather and a club it keeps forgetting the size of. Winter rolls off its shoulders; so do most of its thoughts.

stages.title: Flamehand Bouldergrum
stages.description: A flame-handed colossus of the deep peaks, embers banked in its knuckles, footsteps felt three valleys over. It is gentle, until the ground stops being.

lore: Bouldergrum is very careful with its club indoors. It has broken four doorframes being careful.
goldenLore: Mountain-made and mountain-sized, an elder giant that predates the roads around its feet. It is still very careful with its club indoors. It has never once succeeded.

name: Ratterbone

stages.title: Ratterbone
stages.description: A loose-jointed skeleton warrior that rattles back upright every time it's knocked flat, mildly annoyed and out of good reasons to stop. It doesn't recall who it was.

stages.title: Ratterbone the Unbroken
stages.description: An unbroken revenant, bones scavenged and re-lashed with wire and spite, still gripping a notched blade. Whatever oath raised it, it has long outlasted the one who swore it.

stages.title: Deathless Ratterbone
stages.description: A deathless undead champion in dented, ceremonial plate, guarding a crypt whose name it no longer remembers. It only remembers that it is still standing, and intends to stay that way.

lore: Ratterbone doesn't remember who it was. It only remembers that it's still standing, and it intends to keep it that way.
goldenLore: The unending — knocked down more times than any living army could count, and upright every single time. Death has stopped keeping score.

name: Wisplume

stages.title: Wisplume
stages.description: A pale, drifting spirit that lingers near warm windows and cold graves alike, never quite arriving. It is looking for something, or someone; it has forgotten which.

stages.title: Wisplume the Wandering
stages.description: A wandering ghost gone thin with years of searching, chill trailing behind it like a hem. It still turns toward every lantern in every passing town.

stages.title: Sorrowveil Wisplume
stages.description: A sorrow-veiled shade of real presence and older grief, the air frosting where it passes. It weeps without sound, and the weeping is somehow the gentlest thing about it.

lore: Wisplume drifts toward warm lantern-light in every town it passes, and no one's quite sure if it's looking for something — or someone.
goldenLore: Farewell-bound and never quite gone, a spirit that mastered patience the long way. It has stopped searching — now it simply keeps the light company.

name: Glabbertongue

stages.title: Glabbertongue
stages.description: A squat swamp-frog the size of a shield, all throat and appetite, snapping flies from the reeds. Its croak is far bigger than the rest of it, which is saying something.

stages.title: Glabbertongue the Bellower
stages.description: A bellowing cave-frog grown grotesquely large in the dark under the marsh, tongue like a whipcrack. Fishermen three towns over have blamed its call on thunder.

stages.title: Marshking Glabbertongue
stages.description: The marsh-king itself, a colossal amphibian throned in bog-water and moonlight, swallowing whole what smaller things flee. The swamp holds its breath when it sings.

lore: Glabbertongue's croak has startled fishermen three towns over. It has no idea, and wouldn't care if it did.
goldenLore: Bog-eternal, throat like a war-drum, sovereign of every reed and ripple. Its croak has startled kingdoms; it has never once noticed, and never once cared.

name: Stingrilla

stages.title: Stingrilla
stages.description: A skittering desert scorpion, small and shiny and far too confident about its tail. It taps that tail on stone just to hear the click, which is not, technically, a threat.

stages.title: Stingrilla the Armored
stages.description: An armored king-scorpion grown past all reasonable scorpion size, plates locking like a war-machine. 'Things shouldn't get that big,' say the miners, from a distance, running.

stages.title: Ironshell Stingrilla
stages.description: The iron-shelled venom-queen of the dunes, a scorpion the size of a cart, tail arched like a siege-hook. The sand goes quiet wherever her shadow crosses it.

lore: Stingrilla has never actually stung anything on purpose. It just likes the sound its tail makes when it taps.
goldenLore: Sandborn sovereign, empress of every crack and crevice in the deep desert. She has still never stung anything on purpose — she simply never has to.

name: Grimshank

stages.title: Grimshank
stages.description: A shuffling zombie stitched from whatever the graveyard had spare, arriving late to everything by policy. Slow, patient, and impossible to convince it's finished.

stages.title: Grimshank the Scavenged
stages.description: A scavenged corpse-brute, re-armored in grave-iron and grudges, dragging one boot and no apologies. Cut a piece off and it just picks the piece back up.

stages.title: Deadmarch Grimshank
stages.description: A dead-march warlord at the head of a silent, rotting column, banner made of its own bindings. It has no destination. It simply keeps arriving.

lore: Grimshank shuffles everywhere, arrives late to everything, and has never once failed to arrive.
goldenLore: The twice-risen, buried more thoroughly than anything has a right to survive, upright anyway. It is always late, and it has never, ever failed to come.

name: Howlrend

stages.title: Howlrend
stages.description: A lean grey wolf-pup with too much voice and not enough sense, howling at anything round and bright. It has a personal, unexplained grudge against one fence post.

stages.title: Howlrend the Frostcoat
stages.description: A frost-coated wolf run hard and lean by the winter woods, eyes like lamplight on snow. It runs down whatever runs, and walks beside whatever doesn't.

stages.title: Alpha Howlrend
stages.description: The alpha of a moon-chosen pack, huge and scar-muzzled, its howl answered from every ridge at once. Where it turns its head, the pack is already moving.

lore: Howlrend howls at the moon, the sun, and one specific fence post it has never forgiven.
goldenLore: Moon-chosen and mountain-famed, an elder wolf whose howl the valleys memorized. It still howls at that one fence post. The post has learned to be afraid.

name: Moankettle

stages.title: Moankettle
stages.description: A wailing spirit in tattered shrouds whose voice alone makes ears ache and milk turn. It considers curdling your soup at forty paces a sincere compliment to the soup.

stages.title: Moankettle the Stormtorn
stages.description: A storm-torn banshee grown into her grief, hair like blown smoke, keening on a wind only she can hear. Cover your ears; it will not help, but she appreciates the effort.

stages.title: Wailqueen Moankettle
stages.description: The wail-queen, a shrieking sorrow-sovereign whose lament shatters glass and resolve alike. Armies have simply sat down and wept rather than face the chorus she brings.

lore: Moankettle's wail can curdle soup at forty paces. It considers this a compliment to the soup.
goldenLore: The last lament, a voice that outlived every hall it ever emptied. She has stopped screaming to be heard — now the silence listens for her.

name: Gillcrest

stages.title: Gillcrest
stages.description: A frilled marsh lizard-folk, spear in hand and suspicion in both eyes, hissing at ripples in the reeds. It distrusts almost everything, and does so magnificently.

stages.title: Gillcrest the Brute
stages.description: A scaled brute of the swamp-tribes, broad-backed and war-painted, fanning its frill at anything that moves wrong. It has never lost an argument it could resolve with a spear.

stages.title: War-Shaman Gillcrest
stages.description: A war-shaman of the lizard-folk, storm-marked and rattling with charms, calling marsh-lightning down on trespassers. Its frill, fully flared, has ended battles by intimidation alone.

lore: Gillcrest fans its frill at anything it distrusts. It distrusts almost everything, magnificently.
goldenLore: Frill-sovereign of the whole drowned delta, every tribe bent to its hiss. It still distrusts everything. Everything, it turns out, was right to be nervous.

name: Knucklemaw

stages.title: Knucklemaw
stages.description: A lump of a young mountain troll, named — in the proper troll fashion — after the first thing it ever tried to eat. Which was a rock. It is still proud of this.

stages.title: Knucklemaw the General
stages.description: A troll grown into a 'general' by the simple logic of being the largest thing willing to give orders. It leads by hitting problems until they agree with it.

stages.title: Frostclub Knucklemaw
stages.description: A frost-clubbed troll-king of the high passes, hauling a chunk of glacier it uses as a weapon and, occasionally, a stool. Avalanches move out of its way.

lore: Knucklemaw is named, in the proper troll fashion, after the first thing it ever tried to eat.
goldenLore: Ridge-unbroken, peak-crowned, and still named after a rock. It has eaten stranger things since, but the name, it feels, has aged into a title.

name: Tidecoil

stages.title: Tidecoil
stages.description: A luminous young sea-serpent, no bigger than an eel, its lure-light already flickering hopefully in the dark shallows. It has hypnotized two seagulls and itself, once.

stages.title: Tidecoil the Luminous
stages.description: A glowing coil of deep-water serpent, ribboning through the reefs, drawing curious fish straight into its patient smile. The light is beautiful. That is the entire trap.

stages.title: Deepcrest Tidecoil
stages.description: A deep-crested leviathan-serpent of the trenches, lantern-eyed and mile-long, coiling through water that never sees the sun. Sailors call the glow below 'the second moon' and row for shore.

lore: Tidecoil's lure has hypnotized many a fish, two seagulls, and at least one very distracted fisherman.
goldenLore: Current-eternal, tide-woven, a serpent that has swum every sea into one memory. Its lure has hypnotized fish, gulls, and at least one very distracted fisherman.

name: Cindermaw

stages.title: Cindermaw
stages.description: A smoldering hell-pup born from a fire that simply refused to go out, coals for eyes and smoke for breath. It has not yet found a reason to cool down.

stages.title: Cindermaw the Smoldering
stages.description: A smoke-wreathed fire-hound, coat glowing at the seams, leaving scorched pawprints wherever it prowls. Water spells cow it; nothing else even slows it.

stages.title: Ashfang Cindermaw
stages.description: An ash-fanged elder hound of the deep infernal kennels, breath like a forge-door swinging open. It burns alone — a single searing head, and that is more than enough.

lore: Cindermaw was born from a fire that refused to go out. It hasn't found a reason to, either.
goldenLore: Ember-eternal, born of a flame that would not die and grown into one that cannot. The fire that made it long since burned out. It never got the message.

name: Grithstone

stages.title: Grithstone
stages.description: A small stone sentinel perched on a ruin's edge, so still that birds nest on it between the moments it moves. It has been mistaken for masonry for a decade.

stages.title: Grithstone the Weathered
stages.description: A weathered gargoyle of cracked granite and older duty, wings furled, waiting for a signal no one living remembers giving. It moves exactly once, when it matters.

stages.title: Cairnwarden Grithstone
stages.description: A cairn-warden colossus of living stone, a guardian pair's worth of menace folded into one grim silhouette. It has stood over the same ruin longer than the ruin has had a name.

lore: Grithstone has stood in the same ruin for longer than anyone can remember. It moves, exactly once, when it matters.
goldenLore: Ageless warden, carved by no one now remembered, outlasting the walls it was set to guard. It has stood so long it has become the landmark it was protecting.

name: Emberwyrmling

stages.title: Emberwyrmling
stages.description: A hatchling dragon barely bigger than a hound, all wing-elbows and hiccuped sparks, insisting it is already terrifying. Everyone agrees, mostly to be polite.

stages.title: Emberwyrmling the Quickening
stages.description: A quickening young dragon, scales hardening toward true green, its first real dragonfire singeing its own snout as often as anything else. It is getting there. Loudly.

stages.title: Wyrmking Emberling
stages.description: A brutal-grown wyrm-king, full-throated and full of fire at last, claiming ridgelines as its birthright. The 'ling' is gone from all but its name, which it refuses to update.

lore: Emberwyrmling insists it's already terrifying. Everyone agrees, mostly to be polite, while it tries very hard not to trip over its own tail.
goldenLore: First-flame, the hatchling that grew into the horizon and never lost the swagger. It still insists it was always this terrifying. Now, at last, it's right.

name: Basilyre

stages.title: Basilyre
stages.description: A serpentine reptile whose gaze prickles the skin and drains the nerve, forcing hunters to fight it in a mirror's reflection. It practices its stare in every puddle, self-defeatingly.

stages.title: Basilyre the Marbled
stages.description: A marble-scaled basilisk grown long and cold, its stare heavy enough to lock joints at a glance. Meet its eyes directly and your own strength drains away like poured water.

stages.title: Knightgaze Basilyre
stages.description: A knight-gazed basilisk-lord in natural plate, a stare that petrifies and a patience that outlasts armies. Even reflected, its look is a weapon; unreflected, it is a verdict.

lore: Basilyre practices its petrifying stare in every reflective surface it finds, which is, of course, self-defeating.
goldenLore: The unblinking, a gaze that has turned braver things than you to standing stone. It has finally mastered its own reflection — by simply refusing to look away first.

name: Thornkarr

stages.title: Thornkarr
stages.description: A horned, hide-tough brute that shrugs off ordinary blades and can only be cut by leaf-shaped edges. It is impressed exclusively by leaf-shaped things, and by nothing else, ever.

stages.title: Thornkarr the Regrown
stages.description: A regrown brute-beast bristling with new antler-thorns, its wounds sealing over almost as fast as they open. Bring the right blade or bring nothing but regret.

stages.title: Grove-Tyrant Thornkarr
stages.description: A grove-tyrant of antler and thorn-vine, a walking thicket that treats the forest as its own armored hide. Only the keenest leaf-edge finds a way through, and only just.

lore: Thornkarr can only be impressed by leaf-shaped things. It is a very specific creature.
goldenLore: Ever-verdant, a brute so old the forest grew up around it and called it 'elder.' It can still only be impressed by leaf-shaped things. It is a very specific creature.

name: Zalthisk

stages.title: Zalthisk
stages.description: A chittering desert hive-drone, mandibles clicking in what scholars insist is either a war-chant or gossip. It works, it digs, it obeys a queen it has never seen.

stages.title: Zalthisk the Guardian
stages.description: An armored hive-guardian, poison beading on its spurs, standing sentinel at the tunnel-mouths of the deep nest. It does not question orders; it is not entirely sure it could.

stages.title: Hive-Sovereign Zalthisk
stages.description: A hive-sovereign in its own right, a two-formed insect-matriarch crowned in chitin, the swarm bending to its every pheromone. Ten thousand voices click as one when it moves.

lore: Zalthisk clicks its mandibles in what scholars believe is either a war-chant or gossip.
goldenLore: Ten-thousand-voiced, matriarch of a hive that has hollowed a desert into a kingdom. Its mandibles still click constantly — the war-chant and the gossip, now, are the same thing.

name: Pyrgeist

stages.title: Pyrgeist
stages.description: A newborn thing of living obsidian, molten light bleeding through the cracks in its cooling shell. It remembers the mountain it was quarried from, and intends, someday, to visit.

stages.title: Pyrgeist the Bladebound
stages.description: A blade-bound warrior of volcanic rock, edges of natural glass, veins of slow magma pulsing under black armor-plate. It fights with the patience of geology and the temper of a forge.

stages.title: Obsidian Warden Pyrgeist
stages.description: An obsidian warden of the deep fire-caves, a towering figure of stone and banked flame, each footstep a small quake. It has stood guard so long it has half-melted into the floor and reformed.

lore: Pyrgeist remembers the mountain it was quarried from, and intends, someday, to visit.
goldenLore: Forge-born, mountain-made, an elder of molten rock that has outlasted its own volcano. The magma in its veins is older than the sea. It is in no hurry.

name: Dredgemaw

stages.title: Dredgemaw
stages.description: A pale, spined spawnling from the lightless trench, all fins and needle-teeth, surfacing only by accident. It is mostly mouth, and entirely appetite.

stages.title: Dredgemaw the Spinecrest
stages.description: A spine-crested deep-sea horror grown broad and armored, riding storm-currents up from the black. It breaches for shipwrecks, thunder, and — mostly — snacks.

stages.title: Deepking Dredgemaw
stages.description: A deep-king of the abyssal shelf, a reef-scaled leviathan-fish whose jaws could halve a hull. Whole fishing fleets change waters when its silhouette rises under them.

lore: Dredgemaw surfaces only for storms, shipwrecks, and snacks. Mostly snacks.
goldenLore: Trench-crowned, sovereign of a dark no light has mapped. It surfaces only for storms, wrecks, and snacks — and it has stopped bothering to pretend it isn't mostly the snacks.

name: Duskrend

stages.title: Duskrend
stages.description: A wisp of living dark that leaks out of shadowed corners, edges never quite in focus. It doesn't chase. It waits until you've forgotten it's there.

stages.title: Duskrend the Unbound
stages.description: An unbound shadow-demon, a blur of teeth and absence that unmakes the light around it. You will not see it move; you will simply notice, too late, that it has.

stages.title: Duskrend, Dread Herald
stages.description: A dread herald of the deep dark, a void-clad demon-lord trailing tendrils of swallowed light. It arrives in silence and leaves the same way, with less of you than before.

lore: Duskrend doesn't chase. It waits in the smoke until you've forgotten it's there — then reminds you, once, very politely.
goldenLore: Voidcrowned, sovereign of every unlit place a lamp has ever failed. It waits in the smoke until you've forgotten it — then reminds you, once, very politely.

name: Talonrend

stages.title: Talonrend
stages.description: A sharp-eyed young dragon already outgrowing every den it claims, wings finally strong enough for real sky. It is deciding, with great drama, which mountain gets to be next.

stages.title: Talonrend the Sharpening
stages.description: A sharpening chromatic dragon, scales darkening to storm-grey, dragonfire coming in long controlled sheets now. It hunts the high passes and drops on prey like falling weather.

stages.title: Talonrend, Skyreaver
stages.description: A sky-reaver of tempest and talon, riding thunderheads and stooping through them, a full-grown dragon in its terrible prime. The wind changes when it wheels overhead.

lore: Talonrend has already outgrown every den it's tried to claim. It's still deciding which mountain gets to be next.
goldenLore: Stormward, master of the whole vault of sky, every ridgeline below it claimed or scorched. It finally picked its mountain. It picked all of them.

name: Nechrallis

stages.title: Nechrallis
stages.description: A hook-limbed reaper-demon in a tattered shroud, an inverted mark burning on its chest, soul-light where a scythe should be. It calls up one small death-spawn and dotes on it.

stages.title: Nechrallis the Twinshade
stages.description: A twin-shaded greater reaper, taller and colder, two death-spawns trailing it like grim shadows. The ribbons of soul-light it trails are the last thing many things see.

stages.title: Nechrallis, Direreap Ascendant
stages.description: An ascendant direreaper-demon, a hooded harvester wreathed in three chaotic spawn of pure decay. It gardens the dead, patient and precise, and the harvest is always in season.

lore: Nechrallis's death spawns adore it. It pretends not to notice them trailing behind like ducklings.
goldenLore: Deathgardener, elder of the reaping, its soul-lanterns lighting an endless quiet field. Its death-spawns adore it. It pretends not to notice them trailing behind like ducklings.

name: Umbrask

stages.title: Umbrask
stages.description: A hulking beast of living darkness whose fur drinks the light, edges blurring into the cave-black. It is very good at hiding and very bad at remembering its eyes glow.

stages.title: Umbrask the Lightless
stages.description: A lightless dark-beast grown vast and always-hungry, ignoring every instinct that tells lesser things to leave you be. Where it walks, torches gutter and shadows lengthen.

stages.title: Umbrask, Void-Colossus
stages.description: A void-colossus of matted shadow and slow menace, a mountain of dark that light simply bends around. It does not stalk so much as arrive, quietly, at scale.

lore: Umbrask is very good at hiding and very bad at remembering that its eyes glow.
goldenLore: The unseen, an elder darkness that outlived the lamps set to find it. It is still hiding. Its eyes are still glowing. It still hasn't noticed.

name: Vornathax

stages.title: Vornathax
stages.description: A red-hided lesser scion of the demon-hordes, horns budding, a broken shackle still locked on one wrist. It kept the chain — a warning to some, a souvenir to it.

stages.title: Vornathax the Chainbreaker
stages.description: A chain-breaker greater demon, broad as a door and twice as hard to close, brimstone smoking off its shoulders. The manacle it snapped hangs from its belt like a trophy.

stages.title: Vornathax, Brimstone-Crowned
stages.description: A brimstone-crowned demon-general, a war-lord of the infernal legions, its every order answered in fire. It leads the damned not by right but by the simple fact that none will refuse it.

lore: Vornathax keeps its broken chain as a trophy, a warning, and — on cold nights — a scarf.
goldenLore: Shacklefree, an elder demon that broke its bindings so long ago the chain has become legend. It keeps the broken links still — a trophy, a warning, and on cold nights, a scarf.

name: Coilfen

stages.title: Coilfen
stages.description: A wingless young serpent-dragon, a lab-born wyrm that slithers low until threatened, then rears up wrong and quick. One of an old dragonkin experiment's stranger successes.

stages.title: Coilfen the Drakeborn
stages.description: A drake-born middle-form, wingless and furious, venting volcanic breath from gaping sores where wings should be. It is very aggressive, and, to be fair, in some pain about it.

stages.title: Coilfen, Thrice-Crowned
stages.description: A thrice-crowned hydra of the fen, three heads bickering — one spitting venom, the others switching their fury between fang and spell. Cut one off and negotiations only get worse.

lore: Coilfen's three heads agree on almost nothing, except that you are late with dinner.
goldenLore: Fen-eternal, a three-headed elder that mastered every trick its makers built into it. Its heads agree on almost nothing, except that you are late with dinner.

name: Vaelgrim

stages.title: Vaelgrim, Wyrmling of Legend
stages.description: A metal-scaled wyrmling of legend, hide already ringing like struck iron, eyes older than its small body. Kingdoms have risen and fallen; it was a hatchling for one of them.

stages.title: Vaelgrim, the Rising Wyrm
stages.description: A rising metal dragon, plates hardened to living armor, breath a shimmer of heat that warps the air. It remembers the names of the dead realms and recites them when it's bored.

stages.title: Vaelgrim, Elder of the Old Sky
stages.description: An elder of the old sky, a vast metal dragon whose scales turned aside the weapons of forgotten wars. It has outlived every hoard it ever guarded, and does not miss them.

lore: Vaelgrim has outlived kingdoms, and remembers each of their names. It has decided, for now, that yours is worth remembering too.
goldenLore: Sky-sovereign, an ancient of the high wind that has watched the map redraw itself a dozen times. It has decided, for now, that your name is worth remembering too.

name: Solenfyre

stages.title: Solenfyre, the Banked Ember
stages.description: A banked ember of a creature, obsidian shell dimmed to ash-grey, waiting in the cold cave for a reason to burn. Wake it and the coals in its chest flare like a struck forge.

stages.title: Solenfyre the Rekindled
stages.description: A rekindled fire-champion of living rock and rising flame, molten seams reopening across its armored form. It fights the way a wildfire spreads — patiently, then all at once.

stages.title: Solenfyre, Cave-Champion
stages.description: A cave-champion of the deep fire-arena, a towering obsidian warrior clad in its own heat-haze, undimmed by any water thrown at it. It has never once left the arena. It won.

lore: Solenfyre dims to ash-grey when it sleeps and blazes back alight when it wakes. Its neighbors describe this as 'alarming, daily.'
goldenLore: The undimmed, an elder ember that has died down and blazed back more times than anyone kept count. Its neighbors describe this cycle as 'alarming, daily.'

name: Trivandire

stages.title: Trivandire, the Threshold Pup
stages.description: A three-headed hound-pup guarding a threshold far too grand for its size, all six eyes trying very hard to look stern. The heads take turns napping so the gate is never unwatched.

stages.title: Trivandire the Guardian
stages.description: A guardian-grown gate-hound, three heads finally in rough agreement, tri-toned howl echoing down the dark corridor it keeps. Nothing has slipped past it — nothing it will admit to.

stages.title: Trivandire, Gate-Warden
stages.description: A gate-warden of true and awful size, one head breathing ember, one frost, one shadow, and none of them off duty. It stands watch at a door between somewheres, and lets nothing through unbidden.

lore: Trivandire's three heads take turns sleeping so the gate is never unwatched. They have never agreed whose turn it is.
goldenLore: Threshold-eternal, an elder three-headed warden of the gate between worlds. Its heads take turns sleeping so the door is never unguarded. They have never once agreed whose turn it is.

name: Abyzarok

stages.title: Abyzarok, the Quiet Lurker
stages.description: A quiet, drifting spawn of the deep trench, a knot of small tentacles that would rather not be noticed. It lurks under the whirlpool and waits for the water to forget it.

stages.title: Abyzarok the Surfacing
stages.description: A surfacing tentacled horror grown wide as a longship's beam, arms breaching the swell in slow, testing coils. Magic bites it; steel and arrows simply vanish into the dark.

stages.title: Abyzarok, Trench-Colossus
stages.description: A trench-colossus, a leviathan-kraken whose reaching arms can pluck a mast from the sea and a sailor from the deck. It rises only when disturbed, and the ocean disturbs it rarely.

lore: Abyzarok waves with a different tentacle each time, and takes quiet offense if you don't notice.
goldenLore: The deep entire — sovereign of a dark so total the surface is only a rumor to it. It waves with a different tentacle each time, and takes quiet offense if you don't notice.

name: Malgrave, the Hollow Crown

stages.title: Malgrave, the Nameless Regent
stages.description: A nameless, well-dressed regent of the blood-drinking nobility, pale and patient, certain a throne is owed. It does not recall which throne. It recalls, precisely, that it is owed.

stages.title: Malgrave, the Ashen Throne-Bearer
stages.description: An ashen throne-bearer, a vampire-lord grown gaunt and grand, carrying the wreckage of a crown it will not set down. It rules a court of shadows that may be memory, may be real.

stages.title: Malgrave, the Hollow Crown
stages.description: The Hollow Crown itself — a fallen vampire-sovereign fused to the ruin of its own throne, regal decay given fangs. It reigns over an empty hall and calls the silence 'loyal.'

lore: Malgrave does not remember losing its throne. It only remembers that it was owed one — and it has been waiting, patiently, ever since.
goldenLore: The undethroned, an elder of the night-courts that turned losing everything into a kind of victory. It does not remember losing its throne. It remembers being owed one — and it is still, patiently, waiting.

name: Ythrax, the World-Coil

stages.title: Ythrax, the Quiet Coil
stages.description: A quiet coil of serpent in a sun-warmed canyon, deceptively ordinary, deceptively still. It was once mistaken for a common snake. The canyon is now named after the mistake.

stages.title: Ythrax, the Rising Coil
stages.description: A rising coil grown vast and limbless, a serpent thick as an old oak, scales like weathered stone. When it shifts its weight, the ground it rests on remembers it for years.

stages.title: Ythrax, the World-Coil
stages.description: The World-Coil, a primordial serpent so immense its slow turning is felt as far-off tremors. Old prophecies speak of a coiled thing tied to the end of things; the prophets meant this.

lore: Ythrax was once mistaken for an ordinary snake. The canyon it was napping in is now named after the mistake.
goldenLore: Coil without end, a serpent that has looped the horizon and swallowed its own legend whole. It naps for centuries. The world builds carefully around where it lies.
